title: Should India ban cars in old city areas like Jaipur's Walled City?
description: The debate considers whether restricting private cars in historic urban cores such as Jaipur's Walled City would improve mobility, heritage protection and air quality.

facts.fact: UNESCO inscribed Jaipur City, including its planned historic core, on the World Heritage List in 2019.
Jaipur's historic urban fabric includes narrow streets and dense built form that constrain vehicle movement.
Reducing motor-vehicle emissions can improve outdoor air quality and reduce health risks in urban areas.
Car restrictions can displace traffic, parking demand and deliveries to surrounding neighbourhoods without adequate alternatives.
Historic-area traffic policies need to protect resident access, emergency services, deliveries and local businesses.
Restrictions are more effective when supported by reliable public transport, pedestrian infrastructure and enforcement.
